Evidence of absence: No diff hunk in this PR touches tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py or any other test file. The test plan in the PR description confirms only existing tests ran. The CLAUDE.md sunset clause (lines 2315-2318) names three removal targets across two files; no automated check enforces their coordinated removal. The existing test_claude_md_section_28_scopes_auto_decisions (test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:77) checks general §28.C markers but not the Q17 bullet; test_claude_md_section_28c_names_the_interim_twin_first_default (test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:373) checks only the twin-first markers. A stage session following the unchanged step 10 and Auto-Decisions sections on the nine projects listed in the changelog (#4927, #5012, #5125, #5127, #5147, #5148, #5226, #5258, #5298) is now covered by the procedural changes — but if those procedural changes drift or are partially removed without coordinated update, no test catches it.
